_comment: The arms the paper reports. The shipped result files carry a few further exploratory arms; this file -- and only this file -- decides what the analysis compares. Changing the paper's comparison set is a change to this file, not to any result file. Every analysis script loads it through analysis/_config.py; none of them carries an arm list of its own.
_excluded_comment: excluded_arms names any arm that is present in the shipped result files but must never enter a reported comparison. It is empty: every arm the result files still carry is either named by a study roster or reached by no reported item at all. The mechanism stays because it is the only place such an exclusion may be written down.
_studies_comment: Each study reports a different subset, and they are NOT interchangeable: the matched-cost table runs five seeds and omits the hull (which has no admissible cell at any budget), while the certification study runs eight seeds and compares a different control set. Listing them separately is what keeps a script from silently borrowing another study's roster.

matched_cost_table._note: trust_region_hull is a reported baseline but has no admissible cell at any budget, so it is not one of this table's columns; see the OptiCL comparison instead.

certification_study._constants_comment: The certification constants of section 4: the risk target gamma, the familywise error budget delta, the number of certified margins K, and the number of certification objectives n per margin. The per-margin level is epsilon = delta / K. src/ocl/certify.py reads them from here and carries no defaults of its own.

equal_cost_panel._note: this panel discovers its comparators from the stored perf rows; the only roster decision it makes is to drop excluded_arms.

fcs_diagnostic._note: the FCS diagnostic compares surrogate/conformal CONFIGURATIONS, not arms; it has no roster in the sense the other studies do.
